'''Swartz BBQ''' was located in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. It featured a big [[Color|red]] neon sign written in [[Aurebesh]].<ref name="Kenobi" />

==Behind the scenes==
The location shares its name with ''Star Wars'' producer [[John Swartz]].<ref name="Kenobi" />
